page.layout: One column of text, running from top to bottom. Running head at top, page number 457 at top right. Last line "buit" at the foot, with the gathering signature "X" at the centre-bottom.

main_text.p: barbare vocant portum (portationem) armorum, & salvæ guardiæ regiæ infractionem, hoc est, rei, quæ sub manu & profectione regia posita erat, direptionem: quatuor alios lapsu temporis ad-diderunt, tum rex actor erat, tum contra litis ordinem Clericus reus regis actoris forum sequi tenebatur, quia, inquiunt, rex non litigat in curia subditi.

2. Cum Clericus literis sua manu aut sigillo signatis obligatus est, licet actio ista sit mere personalis, vocari potest ad curiam Secularem, & tenebitur respondere literas istas suas esse fateri aut negare.
3. Si Judicem Laicum in tribunali seden-tem injuria affecerit.

4. Cùm Clericus prophanæ administrationi sese immiscet, illius administrationis rationem Laico Judici reddere tenetur, cùm tamen Judicem plerique hoc postremum aggredi religione aliqua percussi reformidarent.
Franciscus I. à Clemente VII. Bullam obtinuit, qua id illi concessum fuit; quæ in Parlamento publicè lecta est & registrata Anno 1531[?]. sic fere se res ha-buit.

page.notes: Printed page 457, running head "Card. BARBERINO." with the page number at top right. Items 2, 3 and 4 are numbered theses set as separate paragraphs; item 4 begins mid-line after "affecerit." in the print. "Anno 1531": the digits are worn and read as 1531 with doubt, so marked [?]. "ad-diderunt": the line-end hyphen is faint, so the word is copied as printed with its hyphen. "qua" is printed "qva" and is normalised for u/v only. Bottom "X" is the gathering signature.
